# Career Decoder

> Career Decoder is an AI-powered platform for personalized career recommendations, skill gap analysis, learning roadmaps, resume and LinkedIn intelligence, and interview preparation.

Career Decoder helps professionals identify high-fit careers, close skill gaps with tailored learning plans, sharpen their resume and portfolio, and prepare for interviews with adaptive AI mock sessions.
